title: Full Stack AI Engineer (React/Node/TypeScript/LLMs)
description: #### **The Company** We help Australian and US businesses hire high calibre remote talent from Sri Lanka. We are a boutique talent partner that works with a limited number of clients and a highly selective pool of talent. Rather than focusing on volume, we focus on quality and long term partnerships. We build dedicated teams across Finance, Technology and Operations, allowing businesses to scale with exceptional talent at a fraction of local hiring costs. Our consultants work as an extension of your team while we handle recruitment, HR, payroll and compliance. #### **Employment Details** - Employment Type: Long-term Contract - Work Arrangement: Fully Remote / Work from Home - Working Days: Monday to Friday (Weekdays) - Working Hours: Semi-aligned with AEST - Communication: Good English communication skills, both written and verbal #### **The Role** We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join an Australian client. This is a full-time role, 40 hours per week, and semi-aligned to the Australian time zone. #### **Requirements** - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. - 2+ years experience building full stack applications using React, Next.js, Node.js and TypeScript. - Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar AI platforms. - Experience building AI powered applications, chatbots, AI agents, automations, or workflow solutions. - Experience working with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar databases. - Understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, third party integrations, and modern software architecture. - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, Vercel, Railway, or similar. - Experience with prompt engineering, AI model integrations, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). - Strong English communication skills. #### **Responsibilities** - Design, develop, and maintain AI-powered web applications. - Build scalable frontend applications using React and Next.js. - Develop backend services, APIs, and integrations using Node.js and TypeScript. - Integrate AI models and services into production applications. - Build AI agents, automation workflows, chat interfaces, and intelligent business tools. - Design and optimize databases, application performance, and system architecture. - Collaborate with international teams, stakeholders, and product managers. - Follow best practices in software development, testing, security, and documentation. - Deliver high quality work within timelines with minimal supervision.

title: Senior Quality Engineer (Automation)
description: About Verdentra We are a team of expert technologists with a shared passion for building technology solutions responsibly, whilst focusing on business outcomes. Our mission is to weave excellence, innovation, and sustainability into the very fabric of the digital landscape, and we specialize in Cloud, Data, AI, and emerging technologies. We maintain solid collaborations with top-tier Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) in the US, providing us with a strong foundation to address complex challenges and deliver business outcomes. What you’ll gain: Build Cutting-Edge Automation: Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, and beyond. Be a Quality Advocate: Work closely with developers, architects, and product teams to embed quality throughout the SDLC, influencing how products are built, tested, and released. Sharpen Your Expertise: Take on complex testing challenges, from end-to-end automation to performance and reliability, while driving improvements in efficiency and coverage. Collaborate & Grow: Share your insights with peers, contribute to best practices, and continuously upskill in the latest QE tools, DevOps practices, and industry trends. Mentor and Inspire: Lead, mentor, and coach junior QE engineers, sharing your expertise and driving the team’s technical maturity and best practices. Stay Ahead: Explore and adopt emerging QE methodologies and technologies that keep testing practices modern, lean, and impactful. Who We Are Looking For: A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 4+ years of solid hands-on experience in QE automation tools such as Playwright Proven ability to build and maintain automated testing frameworks and contribute to end-to-end QE strategies. Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills to identify root causes quickly and effectively. Experience in integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or similar). Solid understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and working effectively in fast-paced environments. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence through expertise. Exposure to AI-driven testing tools and AI-based automation frameworks will be an added advantage. Ready to take your next step?

title: Full Stack Developer - Trainee
description: Industry Enterprise Software / SaaS / AI Work Location Negombo, Sri Lanka (On-site) About Enhanzer Enhanzer is building the next generation of AI-powered enterprise software platforms. We believe great companies are built by great people, strong brands, continuous innovation, and exceptional customer experiences. We’re looking for a passionate, curious, and proactive Full Stack Developer –Associate to become a member of our Engineering team. This is more than a traditional development role. You’ll work closely with developers, product teams, and management to build and enhance software products, solve technical challenges, and contribute to delivering high-quality solutions for local and international customers. Your Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications using Angular and C# .NET Core. Build responsive, user-friendly interfaces using Angular, HTML, CSS, and TypeScript. Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and third-party system integrations. Design and optimize SQL Server databases, queries, and stored procedures. Translate functional requirements into reliable technical solutions. Prepare test cases and test scenarios for developed features. Perform thorough developer testing, including functional, validation, negative, and regression testing. Write and maintain unit tests and integration tests to ensure application reliability. Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve issues across frontend, backend, API, and database layers. Write clean, scalable, secure, and maintainable code following development standards. Participate in code reviews and continuously improve development and testing practices. Your Responsibilities Collaborate with QA, product, and other teams to deliver quality features on time. Use AI-assisted development and testing tools effectively to improve productivity and code quality. Take ownership of assigned tasks from development through testing, bug fixing, and delivery. What We’re Looking For Graduates or undergraduates in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, with a professional qualification in Information Technology. At least 6 months of internship experience in a related role. Hands-on experience in Full Stack Development using the Angular and C#.NET Core tech stack, with a solid foundation in HTML/CSS principles and a proven ability to develop userfriendly web applications. Proficient in designing and integrating RESTful APIs and working with SQL Server databases to build robust backend systems. Experience with Microservices architecture and GraphQL is an added advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for effectively addressing technical challenges. High attention to detail, with a strong motivation to learn and adapt to new technologies, features, and updates. Ability to work effectively under minimal supervision, demonstrating initiative and self-direction. Capacity to build and maintain positive relationships, foster cooperation, and provide support to colleagues and stakeholders. Added Advantages Knowledge of programming languages such as Python. Understanding of OOP and software development principles. Familiarity with Git and version control systems. Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies. Experience with academic, personal, or open-source software projects. What You’ll Gain Practical experience in software development and engineering. Exposure to SaaS, enterprise software, cloud, and AI products. Hands-on experience in application development, APIs, databases, and debugging. Experience working with modern development tools, frameworks, and technologies. Opportunity to work closely with developers, QA engineers, product teams, and management. Career growth based on performance and continuous learning. Career Path Full Stack Developer– Trainee → Full Stack Developer → Senior Full Stack Developer → Tech Lead / Full Stack Architect Join us in building the future of AI-powered enterprise software. If you’re passionate about software development, problem-solving, and building innovative technology solutions, we’d love to hear from you.
